programme.title: The Zoo: Beloved Bugs
programme.desc: The zoo anxiously awaits the arrival of a snow leopard called K2's fourth cub the staff is pleased when a pair of Andean condors embrace their new enclosure, while a squirmy binturong fights his annual vaccination.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Billion Dollar Dogs
programme.desc: Discovering the wide variety of jobs dogs are capable of.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Silent Scream
programme.desc: A polar bear chases down Erin Greene as she walks home from a Halloween party in a small arctic town a bull shark attacks triathlete Chuck Anderson in the Gulf of Mexico, biting his arm and pulling him to the ocean floor.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Big Day for Baby Rhino
programme.desc: Terri helps prepare the zoo's new baby rhino, Carrie, to receive a lifesaving vaccine Robert is on a rescue mission to save two black swans in very bad shape Bindi tries to determine if a cranky wombat named Poa might be pregnant.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Top Cats
programme.desc: Tom is called out to Olympia on a late night rescue mission neighborhood dog chases large indoor cat, Earl, high up on a tree and doesn't exactly let Tom rescue him Play-Play needs rescuing in La Conner.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: At All Costs
programme.desc: Ivan goes on a journey to save his friend's 19 rhinos from the poaching epidemic now sweeping through South Africa. The solution: a logistical nightmare of transporting the entire herd to a secure location 600 miles across the country.

programme.title: Great White Shark Babies
programme.desc: Dr. Mauricio Hoyos teams up with Michelle Jewell and Toby Daly-Engel in search of where the pregnant females of Guadalupe have their pups. Mauricio believes they go to the coast of Baja, but what they find while they're there is a Shark Week first.

programme.title: The Zoo: Fawns Become Friends
programme.desc: Two sickly newborn fawns form an unbreakable bond while they are hand-reared by staff the leopard Khazo gets a surprise that enhances its life, and tensions run high as the reptile staff attempts to collect blood from Cuban crocs.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Running Free
programme.desc: Follow stray pups in Thailand through the first weeks of their dangerous lives. And in Kathmandu, dogs are worshiped and dressed with garlands for the Tihar festival.
